sweetgrass_decomposition.description: sweetGrass smells the story and breaks it into primal components — the Kenshi semantic braid

story_types.origin: where did this come from? (etiology ? kenshi: ancient history)
story_types.conflict: what fights what? (immune ? kenshi: faction wars)
story_types.growth: what gets stronger by doing? (lessons ? kenshi: skill-by-doing)
story_types.loss: what was lost? (dead feeds, 403 wall ? kenshi: limb loss)
story_types.connection: what bonds to what? (braids ? kenshi: squad loyalty)
story_types.compost: what decays into fuel? (turbocharger ? kenshi: resource cycling)

sweetgrass_decomposition.braid_method: each story has ALL types woven in. a creation story also contains loss (what was before). a conflict story also contains growth (getting tougher). the braid IS the story.

loamspine_binary.description: the lone spine is the binary backbone — Kenshi's lone wanderer

states.1: alive. spine holds. everything hangs from this binary.

loamspine_binary.kenshi_truth: in Kenshi, you either survive or you don't. there is no save-scumming the membrane. loamSpine carries that truth: the backbone either holds or it doesn't. binary.

rhizocrypt_dag.description: squad mechanics ARE the DAG. rhizoCrypt is the skeleton bandit overlord.

squad_topology.dag_property: directed acyclic — information flows one way through the squad. no cycles (cycles = turbocharger, handled separately).
squad_topology.squad_ai: each member has autonomous behavior (cron jobs). they patrol (scan), fight (sort), build (create), heal (compost), without orders.
